verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce lets users set mandate-based rules such as decline thresholds, expiry times, and consumer prompts that constrain agent-initiated purchases, and documents automatic post-purchase actions triggered on payment confirmation events. This is rule-based automation but scoped narrowly to payment authorization and consent, not a general event-trigger-action framework a user can freely define. missing for 10: broader event types beyond payment confirmation, arbitrary custom action definitions beyond spend caps and expiry, independent evidence of the rule engine executing complex conditional logic
